prompt: Image 1 is a finished frame of an animation. Draw the very next key frame of the same shot: exactly the same camera angle, framing, scale, room, bed or floor, background, colors, line work, paper and lighting as image 1, and the same main character in the same place and size. Image 2 is the main character's reference: keep exactly its head, face, colors and markings. Its ear on the viewer's left is folded down and its ear on the viewer's right stands up, exactly as in the reference image, whichever way it turns; when the character is seen from behind, the folded ear is on the viewer's right The only change from image 1: one large closed white envelope with a few black ink blots has fallen from above and now lies on the main character's back and the back of its head, as big as half of the main character; under its weight the main character is pressed even flatter into the floor, its eyes are squeezed shut, its cheeks squashed outward, its ears pushed flat; two small puffs of grey dust rise from the floor on both sides of it; the small envelope far in the background is gone; the flame on the tip of its tail is a tiny dim ember with a thin wisp of grey smoke. Everything else stays exactly as in image 1. Every surface is clean and unmarked: blank paper, blank screens, plain envelopes.
